name: herdr-simple-orchestrate
description: DEPRECATED - the old way of orchestrating agents in Herdr: take the orchestrator role, and orchestrate a code review of related pull requests with reviewer agents in worktrees. Requires the herdr plugin.

interface.shortDescription: The old orchestrator role and multi-PR code review for Herdr.
interface.longDescription: The orchestrator role and the orchestrated code review of related pull requests, moved out of the herdr plugin so herdr only teaches Herdr. Deprecated: kept so existing setups keep working. Requires the herdr plugin.
defaultPrompt: Review these pull requests together with reviewer agents.
